blurb: Prairie Rose Equestrian Center offers horse riding lessons in English and Western disciplines for all ages, including private and group lessons. They provide horse boarding with regular and super stalls, daily care, and additional horse care services. The center supports 4-H riders and hosts dressage clinics.
